subject: [PATCH v2 08/11] zsmalloc: encode 1-based obj_idx so valid obj is never 0

reviews.author: Nhat Pham
reviews.summary: Identified potential contention issues with pool lock acquisition and suggested that folding zs_obj_write() into zs_store() could help mitigate this.

2026-11-10.patch_summary: The patch aims to simplify zsmalloc by folding zs_obj_write() into zs_store().
